description: This file contains TypeScript code for loading and parsing tsconfig files, including handling of extends, references, and options like allowJs and paths.

classes.name: TsConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the parts of tsconfig that are relevant for this loader.

classes.name: LoadedTsConfig
classes.description: Interface representing the loaded and resolved tsconfig with additional properties.

methods.name: loadTsConfig
methods.description: Main function to load and parse a tsconfig file, including references.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Resolves the path to a referenced config file, appending .json if missing.

methods.name: innerLoadTsConfig
methods.description: Recursively loads a tsconfig file, handling extends and references, with caching.

methods.name: StripBom
methods.description: Removes BOM characters from a string if present.
